title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre - Stanford University on 1982-10-10

ai_review.summary: Matrix recording of a stellar 1982 Barn Burner show with great Jerry tones and a solid mix, the earlier Crazy Fingers sync glitch now fixed.
ai_review.review: The performance is described as a “stacked” and “Barn Burner” show, highlighted by Jerry Garcia’s superb guitar tone and high‑energy set flow. The matrix source provides a clean, well‑balanced mix, though reviewers note that a 45‑second segment of Crazy Fingers was originally out of sync before being repaired in this version.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical praise (70% weight) combined with a generally good matrix recording despite an early sync issue that has been fixed (30% weight) yields a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix praised as clear and well‑balanced; original release had a 45 s Crazy Fingers segment out of sync, which has been corrected in the current source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers highlight a tight, high‑energy flow with seamless transitions, especially in the noted standout cuts.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar tone is called out as great throughout the show.
